business_summary.text: Vidhi Specialty Food Ingredients Limited is a leading manufacturer of synthetic food colors and specialty ingredients, serving diverse industries including food, pharmaceuticals, and cosmetics with a global footprint across 80 countries.

call_points.text: Management expects meaningful new revenue streams from strategic initiatives like Coat Icon and two new projects under development.
EBITDA margin expanded by ~400 bps YoY due to favourable product mix shift towards higher-margin specialty products.
FY27 expects full utilization of Dahej and Roha facilities
CoatIcon tablet coating system in aggressive sampling phase with global pharma companies
Debt-to-equity ratio remains very low at 0.28%, providing financial flexibility
Geopolitical tensions impacting demand in key export markets like Bangladesh and Philippines

operating_notes.text: Value-added products currently contribute 5% to portfolio, expected to reach 10-12% in FY27
CoatIcon tablet coating system in aggressive sampling phase with 6-month approval process
New product lines expected to have thin competition and excellent margin profile
Pilot plant ready for new capacity at Roha (Arjun) with product under sampling stage
Pilot plant ready for new capacity at Dahej with product sampling to begin soon

timeline.summary: Vidhi Specialty Food Ingredients held Q4 & FY26 earnings conference call on May 14, 2026, reporting flat revenue at ₹380 Cr with improved EBITDA margin to 20.52%, and outlining capex plans of ₹80-97 Cr in FY27 for new product lines.
Vidhi Specialty Food Ingredients reported Q1FY27 results with revenue of ₹146.3 Cr, up 66.4% YoY, and PAT of ₹17.1 Cr, up 34.7% YoY, driven by higher demand and a shift to higher-margin products.
